summary: Backend testing for Lingua Franca API completed successfully. 51/51 pytest tests passed covering public endpoints, auth guarding (22 protected endpoints all correctly return 401 without Bearer token), and full authenticated flows using a directly-injected Mongo session (bypassing Emergent OAuth). Stripe checkout returns a valid URL + session_id and payment record persists. TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at exists. No _id leaks detected in any tested response.

minor.issue: Uses ReportCreate model (fields target_name+reason). The 'reason' field is required but unused for block. Semantically odd; clients must send a reason to block a user. Consider a dedicated BlockCreate model with only target_name.
daily_goal_completed_minutes reset-on-new-day logic is computed inline in the response but never persisted. Cosmetic — actual persistence happens on next _apply_xp call.
STRIPE_API_KEY is not set explicitly in /app/backend/.env; code falls back to hardcoded default 'sk_test_emergent'. Works in test env, but should be exposed as env for clarity/prod-readiness.

action_items: (Optional) Introduce dedicated BlockCreate model for POST /api/block instead of reusing ReportCreate.
(Optional) Add STRIPE_API_KEY to /app/backend/.env explicitly rather than relying on code-level default.
(Optional) Persist daily_goal_completed_minutes reset in /api/home instead of computing inline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 851 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, lessons, vocab, social, rooms, payments).
get_current_user returns raw user dict rather than a typed model — acceptable but a Pydantic model would be safer.
All responses correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} — verified.
Startup creates required indexes (unique on email/user_id/session_token/session_id, TTL on expires_at) — verified.
Full-flow auth simulated via direct Mongo insert of a fake user_sessions doc — works cleanly, confirming get_current_user is the single source of truth for auth.
Stripe checkout uses server-authoritative pricing (STRIPE_PLANS dict) — good security posture; client cannot manipulate amount.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture inserts one TEST_ user + user_sessions doc directly into Mongo with a 1-day-future expiry; all created data (users, sessions, lesson_progress, daily_challenges, speaking_tests, calls, friend_requests, reports, payments, non-seed rooms) is cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py — uses MONGO_URL from /app/backend/.env for direct session injection and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API base. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_backend_api.py -v`. Frontend UI/integration testing remains for a future iteration.
